prompt:

Price action as of 2026-03-19: 1w -3.9%, 1m -8.3%, 3m +4.1%. Last close 28.98. 21d annualized realized volatility 28%. Position in trailing 63-day range: 31% (0%=low, 100%=high).
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:

raw_response:

Realized volatility is unremarkable and offers no offsetting signal of an imminent reversal. On a 20-trading-day horizon this configuration points to continued downside pressure.

DECISION: SELL
